summary: This Printers class is a comprehensive iOS UI page object model for HP Smart mobile app printer management. It extends SmartFlow base class and implements the Page Object Model pattern with extensive printer discovery, connection, and setup workflows. Key features include: (1) Multiple printer discovery methods (WiFi, Ethernet, IP address, serial number, Bonjour), (2) Robust error handling with configurable timeouts and exception control, (3) Platform-specific implementations for iOS and MAC, (4) Retry logic for unstable network conditions, (5) Comprehensive UI validation methods for all printer-related screens, (6) Support for both new printer setup and previously used printer reconnection, (7) Bluetooth and WiFi connectivity handling, (8) Search and filter functionality for printer lists, (9) Analytics integration for tracking printer counts, (10) Help and support navigation features. The class demonstrates enterprise-grade test automation patterns with extensive locator management, wait strategies, and user flow orchestration for complex printer onboarding scenarios.
